timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,500 KRW per USD

WHY: The won is currently weak, with the USD/KRW rate in the 1,500 range and rising (up 13.70 won today following hawkish Fed signals). News indicates this high-rate environment is likely to persist longer term, meaning you're paying more Korean won than usual for each US dollar.

TIP: Consider setting up a standing order to spread your $2,000 monthly purchases across multiple smaller transactions throughout the month, rather than converting in one lump sum, to average out unfavorable rate levels.
